description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 extends Attachment with filenodeId (link to Space file tree node, makes blobId/filename/contentType/size/sha256 optional) and thumbnailBlobId (preview blob). Neither field exists on Attachment in crate-jmap-chat-types.
title: Add Attachment.filenodeId and thumbnailBlobId for FileNode integration
